examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{助|たす}けがなければ{成功|せいこう}できなかった。
examples.english: Without her help, I couldn't have succeeded.

examples.japanese: {困|こま}った{時|とき}に{助|たす}けを{差|さ}し{伸|の}べてくれる{友人|ゆうじん}がいるのは{幸|しあわ}せだ。
examples.english: It's fortunate to have friends who offer help in times of need.

notes:
{助|たす}け is the noun form derived from the verb {助|たす}ける (to help, to rescue).

Common expressions:
- {助|たす}けを{求|もと}める (to seek help)
- {助|たす}けを{呼|よ}ぶ (to call for help)
- {助|たす}けを{借|か}りる (to borrow help from someone)
- {助|たす}けになる (to be of help)
- {助|たす}けを{差|さ}し{伸|の}べる (to extend a helping hand)

Related words:
- {助|たす}ける (verb: to help)
- {手助|てだす}け (helping hand)
- お{助|たす}け (polite form, often in set phrases)
